stories.title: Major among 4 troops martyred, 24 terrorists killed during operations in KP and Balochistan: ISPR
stories.brief: Four troops, including a major, were martyred while 24 terrorists were killed in multiple intelligence-based operations (IBOs) in Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s North Waziristan, the military’s media wing said on Saturday.

stories.title: Army officer and soldier martyred, 8 terrorists killed in ongoing Balochistan IBOs: ISPR
stories.brief: It said that on the night between Friday and Saturday, "security forces successfully neutralised eight Indian-sponsored terrorists of Fitna al Hindustan (FAH), including a suicide bomber and recovered a large cache of weapons and ammunition" in Kolpur.

stories.title: FO says Climate Minister Musadik Malik nominated to represent Pakistan at SCO moot in New Delhi
stories.brief: The Foreign Office (FO) said on Saturday that Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik had been nominated to represent Pakistan at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisational Dialogue in New Delhi from Nov 20-22.

stories.title: Second catch attempt for SpaceX Starship rocket
stories.brief: The attempt follows an unsuccessful effort to catch of the rocket’s booster which instead came down in the ocean.

stories.title: Microsoft says services fully restored after day-long global outage
stories.brief: Efforts to address the underlying problem with Outlook, Teams and Copilot are complete, the tech firm says.

stories.title: Pakistan to host 30th ECO Council of Ministers meeting on Nov 15-16
stories.brief: The 30th meeting of the Economic Cooperation Organisation (ECO) Council of Ministers will be held in Islamabad on Nov 15 and 16, the Foreign Office (FO) said on Saturday.

stories.title: President Zardari meets PM Shehbaz as debate over new provinces continues
stories.brief: President Asif Ali Zardari met Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif at his Model Town residence on Saturday, amid renewed political debate over the creation of new provinces.

stories.title: Anchorperson Rabia Ahsan's husband gets four more days in police custody
stories.brief: A Rawalpindi court on Saturday remanded Ahsan Tahir, the husband of television anchorperson Rabia Ahsan, to a further four days in police custody in connection with her murder, with his polygraph test to be conducted on November 16.

stories.title: Pakistan to host 30th ECO Council of Foreign Ministers meeting on Nov 15-16
stories.brief: The 30th Meeting of the Economic Cooperation Organisation (ECO) Council of Foreign Ministers will be held in Islamabad on November 15-16, with Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar set to chair the meeting, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) said on Saturday.

stories.title: Italy fines Meta €805m over accessing users' photos
stories.brief: The social media giant is accused of not informing about 20 million users it had access to their photos.

stories.title: Jojo the gorilla has spent his life alone. Can he finally find a companion?
stories.brief: Jojo was poached as an infant and grew up in captivity. His keepers want to find him a friend - but it's not straightforward.

stories.title: How the Jensen Huang scandal created a headache for business-friendly Singapore
stories.brief: The scandal has cast a spotlight on Singapore's success as a chip hub - and a location for alleged illicit trade.

stories.title: Nvidia scandal: US treasury chief blames Lutnick’s commerce department over alleged lack of action
stories.brief: US commerce secretary faces sack as questions emerge over senior Trump officials’ knowledge of alleged Chinese spy’s ties to Jensen HuangUS politics – live updatesThe US commerce secretary, Howard Lutnick, is facing growing pressure over his apparent lack of action over the Nvidia spying scandal as other Trump administration officials publicly raise questions over his…

stories.title: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
stories.brief: Microsoft says it is continuing to restore services including Outlook and Teams following a global outage.

stories.title: How a sex scandal at Nvidia is putting pressure on the White House
stories.brief: Jensen Huang's personal life may have triggered the crisis, but the questions now reach into the White House itself.

stories.title: What we know so far about the Microsoft outage
stories.brief: A Microsoft outage is affecting services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot.

stories.title: Heat pumps: How much heat does your home really need?
stories.brief: Knowing how much heat your home loses is important before installing a new heating system.

stories.title: What happened overnight with the Microsoft global outage?
stories.brief: Microsoft is struggling to fix a global outage, with services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot affected by "connectivity problems".

stories.title: How many sewage spills have happened in your part of Scotland?
stories.brief: More than 76,000 sewage spills were recorded at overflow sites previously unmonitored by Scottish Water, BBC Scotland News analysis has found.

stories.title: Flood victim, 95, lived in Wetherspoons until she died after her home was destroyed
stories.brief: Jean Powell kept asking when she could go back to her flat, which was flooded when the River Monnow burst its banks.
